t: This box can be paired with any Controller. When paired, you can open a GUI to pick which Signal Aspects should emit a Redstone current from the Box. If placed next to a Signal Controller Box it will transmit the Aspect to it as well.
此方块可与任意控制器配对。配对后，您可打开GUI界面，选择哪些信号类型应从该方块输出红石电流。若将其放置于信号控制器旁，它还将把所选信号类型传输给该控制盒。
